hero.subtitle: Genuine and OEM parts for 500+ vehicle models, sourced globally and stocked in Dubai — so the right part reaches your garage, not just your inbox.

about.title: Built for the UAE Driver.
about.body: Ferrum sources genuine and OEM-equivalent parts from certified manufacturers across Asia, Europe and the US, then stocks them locally in Dubai — so you're not waiting weeks for a part that should take a day. From daily maintenance to full rebuilds, our catalogue is matched precisely to what's actually on UAE roads.

brands.title: Authorized to distribute the names you already trust.

why.title: The details that matter more than the sale.
why.genuineBody: Every SKU is sourced directly from the manufacturer or an authorized channel — verified before it reaches our warehouse.
why.deliveryBody: Same-day dispatch within Dubai, next-day across the other Emirates — tracked from our warehouse to your door.
why.supportBody: Send us your VIN or old part photo — our team confirms fitment before you order, not after.
why.returnsBody: Wrong fitment or changed your mind — 30 days to return, no restocking questions asked.

testimonial.quote: Ordered brake pads for my Land Cruiser on a Tuesday morning — they were at my garage in Al Quoz by 3pm the same day. Genuine Brembo, exactly as described.
testimonial.name: Ahmed Al Falasi
